what: Issue: Add error handling around report reactive pipelines to prevent session crashes
title: Data Refresh Workflow
text: Summary Reactive expressions across report modules (QPR qpr_expr_*.R via mod_qpr.R, DQ filtering mod_body_dq_*.R, etc.) tryCatch around data transformations. uncaught error reactive/render (bad date input, empty filter result, transient S3/network hiccup) kills entire Shiny session user recovery — visible user app “crashing.” Goal Uncaught errors report-rendering reactives show friendly -app message (app already depends shinyalert) instead terminating session. Proposed approach - [ ] Identify highest-traffic report modules’ reactive pipelines (QPR, DQ program-level, DQ region-level, CoC Competition) - [ ] Wrap expensive/error-prone reactive expressions tryCatch(), surfacing failures via shinyalert friendly inline message rather letting session die - [ ] Add small reusable helper (e.g. safe_reactive()) pattern consistent across modules rather ad hoc - [ ] Spot-check shinyapps.io instance size vs. -memory size APP_DATA (e.g. lobstr::obj_size(APP_DATA)) rule OOM separate crash cause Acceptance criteria - [ ] Forcing error report’s data pipeline (e.g. temporarily feeding bad date range) shows friendly message instead disconnecting session - [ ] change report output non-error path Notes Complements #55 — issue addresses startup-time data loading; addresses runtime errors session already running. Independent global.R refactor, can done parallel.

what: Issue: Switch report DataTables to server-side processing; add debounce/bindCache to reduce redundant recomputation
title: Data Refresh Workflow
text: Summary Every DT::renderDT()/DT::renderDataTable() call across report modules explicitly passes server = FALSE (15 occurrences, e.g. mod_qpr.R, mod_body_dq_program_level.R, mod_body_coc_competition_mahoning.R), shipping entire table browser JSON every render instead letting DT page server-side (DT’s default server = TRUE). HMIS-sized tables bloats payload can make browser tab sluggish unresponsive. Separately, report modules don’t debounce date-range/picker inputs (mod_body_dq_program_level.R ), dragging slider re-triggers full data pipeline every intermediate value, ’s caching (bindCache()) anywhere, filtered dataset can recomputed multiple times per render (e.g. mod_body_coc_competition_mahoning.R re-derives pe_summary_final_filter() independently 4 separate pivot operations). Goal Reduce perceived “slowness” cutting payload size redundant computation. Proposed approach - [ ] Switch DT::renderDT(..., server = FALSE) server = TRUE across report modules; verify Excel/CSV export buttons still work correctly - [ ] Extend existing debounce() pattern mod_body_dq_program_level.R mod_qpr.R DQ modules - [ ] Consolidate repeated derivations (e.g. pe_summary_final_filter() mod_body_coc_competition_mahoning.R) single reactive reused dependent outputs, adding bindCache() appropriate Acceptance criteria - [ ] Report tables still sort/filter/page/export correctly switching server-side mode - [ ] Dragging date-range input longer triggers visible recompute every intermediate value - [ ] behavior change report output, reduced redundant computation Notes Orthogonal global.R startup refactor (#55) — purely runtime responsiveness, mechanical enough parallelize across contributors.
